name: Callout
summary: A docs-style aside inside long-form content: note, tip, warning or danger, with a titled type.
description: Use a callout in articles and documentation to set a point apart from the text around it. For messages about the state of the app use an alert.

classes.name: v-callout
classes.description: The aside, with a tone rule on the start side. Note (info) tone by default.

classes.name: v-callout-title
classes.description: The first line: an icon and the type name.

classes.name: v-callout-danger
classes.description: Danger tone, for things that cannot be undone.

a11y: The title names the type (Note, Tip, Warning), so the meaning never rests on colour.
An <aside> with aria-label is a complementary landmark; label it with the type so it is easy to find.
Callouts are static content; give them no live role.

examples.title: Four types
examples.html:
Note

Directions ship as separate files. Load one with the core for production.

Tip

Warning

Danger
